title: Normalize API Users
prompt: A TypeScript frontend receives snake_case user objects from an API but the app uses camelCase. Write a function that maps each API user to { id, displayName, isActive }.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Normalize API Users, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A TypeScript frontend receives snake_case user objects from an API but the app uses camelCase. Write a function that maps each API user to { id, displayName, isActive }.
